images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: AI reconstruction of the CURRENT EXISTING Roblox Level 3 beige party room, for reference verification, NOT concept art and NOT a redesign. Input image 1 is the sole authoritative edit target and visual reference. Reconstruct this exact image very faithfully, changing ONLY removal of the CD READER HUD at upper right and flashlight icon at bottom left, filling those areas with the exact continued ceiling/floor. Preserve camera position, portrait framing, room proportions, objects, geometry, colors, materials, composition and low-resolution simple Roblox game rendering. Low dirty beige suspended ceiling with coarse dark square tile grid; existing plain flat rectangular fluorescent lamps only; flat tan beige walls; open rectangular passages at left and right; black rectangular wall speaker on rear wall; dark mottled green, ochre, orange and brown carpet. Preserve exactly the dark reddish-brown folding table in the foreground with thin black folding legs, red plastic chair at front-left, dark chair beyond it, green plastic chair front-right; the smaller green table in the background with existing red/yellow/green plastic chairs and small red/yellow/blue/green balloon cluster. Keep existing relative object placement and perspective extremely close. The ceiling takes nearly the upper half of the image. Maintain dim sickly warm flat fluorescent game lighting and simple polygonal assets; slightly improve clarity only enough to see the existing details without adding anything. No people, no HUD, no captions, no logo, no watermarks. Do not add or redesign architecture, furniture, decorative objects, doors, windows, kiosks, counters, banquettes, plants, arches, ceiling coffers, trims or modern mall luxury. No photorealism, no cinematic redesign, no Frutiger Aero makeover, no water. Deliver one portrait image matching the reference composition.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: faithful reference reconstruction of an existing Roblox game environment.
Input image 1 is the exact visual reference, an actual screenshot of the CURRENT Level 3 orange room. Recreate this specific room faithfully; this is not a redesign or an improvement concept.
Preserve the same portrait camera framing and perspective, large low flat tiled suspended ceiling occupying the upper half, black ceiling grid, sparsely spaced flat rectangular fluorescent ceiling lights, plain dark orange upper walls with a solid BLACK lower wall band, doorless rectangular openings at the back/right, small black rectangular wall speaker on the back wall. Preserve the same sparsely furnished room arrangement: pale speckled plain rectangular folding tables arranged in rows, mismatched red/yellow/green/blue molded plastic chairs, a small cluster of balloons at the back left, and very dark party carpet with tiny red/orange/green/blue confetti dash marks.
Style: keep the simple low-poly Roblox real-time rendering, plain geometry, inexpensive tiled textures, hard flat surfaces and dark yellowish fluorescent lighting of the exact input. Preserve the reference layout and appearance. Lift shadow exposure just slightly so furniture and carpet can be read, but keep the room dim.
Remove only the top-right CD reader HUD and bottom-left flashlight HUD. No interface overlays, labels, captions, watermarks, people or monsters.
Do not add new furniture or architecture. No arcade machines, jukeboxes, planters, decorative wall panels, mall kiosks, glowing trim, photorealism, cinematic art, elaborate rendering, red carpet, Frutiger Aero features or water.
Generate one faithful portrait image matching the reference framing.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: faithful AI reconstruction of an EXISTING Roblox Level 3 screenshot, NOT a redesign or an architectural visualization.
Input image: the attached reference is a direct fresh Roblox Studio Play capture of the CURRENT Red Carpet Party Rooms, seed101, room19, placeversion2403. Treat it as authoritative.
Generate ONE image staying extremely close to the screenshot's actual camera, room arrangement, plain low-polygon Roblox graphics, surfaces and simple furnishing. Remove only the overlaid CD READER HUD in the upper right and flashlight icon in the lower left. The purpose is to show that we understand what the CURRENT level looks like. Keep its plain game appearance; do not beautify, modernize, turn photorealistic, or add imagined architecture.
Preserve the VERY LOW beige square suspended ceiling grid with simple thin black-framed rectangular fluorescent slabs; plain red/orange walls and darker base trim; broad boxy doorless passages into adjacent rooms; red carpet with the same mottled yellow looping pattern and dark spots. Preserve the foreground pale rectangular folding table with dark blue edge and thin black folding legs, the row of green, yellow and black plastic chairs facing it, red and blue plastic chairs on the far side, and more simple table/chairs in the back. Keep all furniture placement and apparent sizes. Keep the partially visible orange balloon at top-right. Retain the ordinary dark warm-yellow Roblox lighting and visible texture tiling. Slightly clearer shadows are allowed, but no cinematic relighting or polished reflections.
Preserve original landscape composition and field of view. No people, no monster, no additional objects, no branding or captions. No plants, no luxurious banquet furniture, no white tablecloths, no arches, no podium or curtains, no mall storefronts, no display cabinets, no coffered ceilings, no water, no Frutiger Aero redesign. Return a close scene reconstruction with HUD removed. The fine pixels may be AI approximations; the existing visual identity must remain unchanged.
